STEM Call 03/2026
Call for Applications: Doctoral Positions in the Life Sciences and Natural Sciences
The University of Vienna invites applications for more than 40 fully funded doctoral positions across a broad range of disciplines in Life Sciences and Natural Sciences. We are seeking highly motivated and talented candidates from around the world who wish to pursue a PhD at the University of Vienna and are committed to excellent, internationally visible research.
We welcome applications from outstanding candidates eager to contribute to high-quality research in one of the following fields:
Chemistry
Computer Sciences
Ecology and Evolution
Microbiology and Environmental Sciences
Pharmaceutical, Nutritional and Sport Sciences
Physics
The University of Vienna offers excellent research infrastructure, first-class supervision, and vibrant scientific community. Doctoral candidates benefit from structured doctoral programmes, opportunities for international collaboration, scientific publishing, and comprehensive professional and career development support preparing them for careers in academia and beyond.

Update: The application deadline was 27 March 2026 at 12:00 CET.
Please note that applications submitted by email after the deadline cannot be considered.
You can still access your submitted application via the Application Portal.
Please do not inquire about the status of your application. All candidates will be informed of the outcome of the selection process as soon as possible. See the FAQs for general information about the selection process and the timeline.
What is it about
Short Facts
Target group:
Ambitious candidates with a strong academic track record who wish to pursue their doctorate in one of the research areas listed below.
Positions:
More than 40 fully funded predoctoral positions. Unless stated otherwise, positions are offered for a duration of 3 to 4 years.
Salary:
According to the collective bargaining agreement: §48 VwGr. B1)
Application period:
2 March – 27 March 2026, 12:00 CET
Application language:
English
Application mode:
Central online application
Please note: Application Deadline was March 27, 2026, 12:00. Applications must be submitted online only; email submissions will not be considered.
More Questions? See our FAQs
How to apply
Make sure to start the application process early!
Step 1: Before applying, ensure that you will have completed a subject-related diploma or master’s degree by the start of your employment.
Step 2: Identify the relevant Doctoral School from the list below.
Step 3: Select a position from the list of open positions. Make sure to indicate the correct doctoral school and supervisor in the application process!
Step 4: Create a u:account and then proceed via the “Apply” link below to submit your application.
Please refer to the User Guide for detailed instructions on how to create and submit your application.

STEM Call 2026 – Online Information Session on Admission for Applicants
Prospective applicants were invited to join an online information session where we focused on admission related topics of the STEM Call 2026, including eligibility criteria, legalisation and translation requirements and answered frequently asked questions.
The session concluded with a live Q&A, where participants could ask questions. Please note that individual case-by-case eligibility assessments could not be provided.
When: 18th March 2026 10:00 - 11:00 | Where: Online (via MS Teams)
